race.comment: BREATHLESS SPIRIT (4) was a beaten favourite fresh up in the Hamilton Cup after getting a long way back in the running, and then making her run without much room along the fence. Rule a line through that run, and stepping out to 2000m here, second up, is the key. Follow your money. TIKEMYSON (3) took gaps, and was well ridden when winning the Avoca Cup 2 weeks ago. He needs the right sort of run, and if he gets the same sort of luck, he is always a top 3 hope. VERONA RUPES (10) finished third in the St Arnaud Cup last week, and that run proved that he is capable of measuring up in this company. Stick with him. OMNIC (9) only battled in the Avoca Cup, but was narrowly beaten in the Coleraine Cup before that. He drops to 52kg after a claim, and is expected to bounce straight back into the money.
